title.en: Shi ni modotta kisaki wa kareinarufukushū o togeru

altTitles.ja: 死に戻った妃は華麗なる復讐を遂げる

altTitles.en: The wife who returned from the dead avenges herself with elegance
The Princess Who Returned from Death Acquires a Magnificent Revenge

description.en:
“Why me? Why am I the one being sentenced to death?”

With eyes burning with rage and hatred, Catherine stood on the execution platform, staring at the world that had betrayed her.

Three years ago, Catherine was sent from her homeland, Woltilla, to the Kingdom of Highland as the Crown Prince’s wife.
But instead of a peaceful royal life, she was caught in filthy conspiracies, framed for crimes she never committed, and sentenced to death.

Her tongue was torn out during torture, leaving her voiceless in her final moments. The crowds cursed her, screamed at her, and rejoiced in her suffering…
And in the midst of this overwhelming injustice and pain — her head fell, and her life came to a tragic end.

But fate had other plans for her…

When she opened her eyes again, she found herself back in time — three years before her death, right at the moment when her tragedy first began.

“This is an opportunity I can’t waste!”

And so begins Catherine’s cold and graceful revenge, determined to bring down every single person who betrayed her — one by one.

A royal revenge story… of a woman wronged by everyone, now returned to become their worst nightmare.
